context.analysis:
## Overview
[An Amazon-style e-commerce online bookstore built on AWS to serve 1M MAU across three global regions. Its core purpose is enabling secure book browsing, purchasing, and AI-driven recommendations while ensuring strict regulatory compliance.]

## Key Elements
*   **Users:** Book Buyer, Site Administrator, Customer Support Representative
*   **Core System:** Online Bookstore System (AWS ECS/EKS containers)
*   **Edge & Caching:** AWS CloudFront CDN, AWS ElastiCache (Redis)
*   **Data Tier:** Amazon Aurora Global Databases, AWS KMS (AES-256)
*   **External Services:** Payment Gateway (Stripe/PayPal), Third-Party Shipping API (FedEx/UPS), Tax Calculation Service (Avalara), Marketing/Email Service Provider (SendGrid/Klaviyo)

## Relationships
*   **Book Buyer / Site Administrator / Support:** Access Online Bookstore System via HTTPS (TLS 1.3) with AWS Cognito OAuth2/OIDC.
*   **Online Bookstore System to Payment Gateway:** HTTPS/REST for tokenized, PCI-DSS compliant checkout redirection.
*   **Online Bookstore System to Shipping API & ESP:** Asynchronous queuing via AWS SQS/EventBridge for order dispatch and marketing triggers.
*   **Online Bookstore System to Tax Service:** HTTPS/REST for real-time multi-currency tax calculations.

## Technology Stack
*   **Cloud Infrastructure:** AWS (us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1) for multi-region deployment.
*   **Compute:** Amazon ECS/EKS for stateless containerized microservices.
*   **Frontend:** AWS CloudFront for global edge content delivery.
*   **Database & Caching:** Amazon Aurora Global Databases and AWS ElastiCache (Redis) for scalability.
*   **Security & Compliance:** AWS Cognito, AWS KMS, AWS CloudTrail for zero-trust access and GDPR/CCPA data protection.

## Rationale
[This architecture guarantees 99.95% availability and sub-2-second page loads globally by leveraging edge caching, stateless containers, and asynchronous queueing. It satisfies strict GDPR, CCPA, and PCI-DSS compliance requirements through tokenized payments, regional data residency guardrails, and automated security pipelines.]

containers.analysis:
## Overview
[A scaled-down Amazon-style e-commerce site for physical and electronic books, providing catalog browsing, secure checkout, reviews, and personalized recommendations.]

## Key Elements
*   **Users & Actors:** Book Buyer, Site Administrator, Customer Support Representative, Content Provider/Publisher
*   **External Systems:** Payment Gateway, Third-Party Shipping API, Tax Calculation Service, Marketing/Email Service Provider, Recommendation Engine/ML Service
*   **Containers:** Single Page Application (SPA), API Gateway, Catalog & Search Container, Order & Checkout Container, Recommendation Container, Localization Container, Analytics & Event Ingestion Container
*   **Infrastructure & Data:** Amazon S3, CloudFront, AWS ECS/EKS, PostgreSQL, Amazon OpenSearch, Amazon SQS/SNS, AWS Kinesis Firehose, AWS Route 53

## Relationships
*   **Book Buyer to SPA:** HTTPS via AWS CloudFront and Route 53 latency-based routing
*   **SPA to API Gateway:** HTTPS with JWT validation and rate-limiting
*   **API Gateway to Containers:** gRPC over mTLS via AWS App Mesh within private VPC subnets
*   **Order & Checkout Container to Payment Gateway:** HTTPS with strict in-memory ephemeral cardholder data processing
*   **Analytics Container to Kinesis Firehose:** High-throughput asynchronous telemetry streaming with PII scrubbing

## Technology Stack
*   **Frontend:** React hosted on AWS S3 + CloudFront for performance (page load < 2s on 3G)
*   **API & Core Backend:** Node.js/Express (Order/Checkout and Localization), Spring Boot (Catalog/Search), Python/FastAPI (Recommendation), Go (Analytics)
*   **Database & Search:** PostgreSQL with multi-region replication, Amazon OpenSearch for keyword search
*   **Messaging & Streaming:** Amazon SQS/SNS for events, AWS Kinesis Firehose for analytics ingestion
*   **Security & Operations:** AWS ECS/EKS, AWS Secrets Manager, AWS IAM, AWS KMS CMKs for regional data residency, AWS App Mesh for mTLS

## Rationale
[This multi-region, containerized architecture isolates the PCI-DSS compliant checkout domain while decoupling high-throughput analytics to ensure 99.95% uptime and scalability for 1M MAU. Leveraging edge delivery and regional AWS infrastructure guarantees sub-2-second page loads and strict GDPR/CCPA data residency compliance.]

Single Page Application (SPA).analysis:
## Overview
- An Amazon-style e-commerce Single Page Application (SPA) providing browsing, search, reviews, recommendations, and checkout for physical and electronic books.
- Built using React and delivered globally via AWS S3 and CloudFront to support 1 million monthly active users (MAU) with sub-2-second 3G load times.

## Key Elements
- Book Buyer, Site Administrator, Customer Support Representative (Users)
- Single Page Application (SPA) (React, AWS S3, CloudFront)
- Catalog & Search Module, Checkout & Cart Module, Localization Context Provider, Compliance & Consent Banner, Analytics & Event Ingestion Client (React Components)
- API Gateway (Node.js)
- Localization Container, Analytics & Event Ingestion Container

## Relationships
- Users -> Single Page Application (SPA): Access application features [HTTPS via AWS CloudFront and Route 53]
- SPA (Catalog Module) -> API Gateway: Fetches book data [HTTPS / REST]
- Localization Context Provider -> Localization Container: Fetches currency rates and dictionaries [HTTPS / REST]
- Analytics Client -> Analytics & Event Ingestion Container: Dispatches telemetry and funnel events asynchronously [HTTPS / REST]

## Technology Stack
- React: Powers the component-based UI for high performance and modularity.
- AWS S3 & CloudFront: Ensures global content delivery and sub-2-second 3G load times.
- HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict Cookies: Manages secure token handling to prevent XSS.
- Content Security Policy (CSP): Mitigates OWASP Top-10 injection and XSS vectors.

## Rationale
- The React SPA architecture directly fulfills high-performance constraints and multi-currency needs across global regions.
- Edge delivery via CloudFront combined with strict security policies ensures GDPR/CCPA compliance and 99.95% availability.

API Gateway.analysis:
## Overview
The Online Bookstore system is an Amazon-style e-commerce platform providing catalog browsing, secure checkout, reviews, and recommendations for 1 million monthly active users. It delivers high scalability, security, and global availability across AWS regions.

## Key Elements
- **Users**: Book Buyer, Site Administrator, Customer Support Representative, Third-Party Content Provider/Publisher
- **External Systems**: Payment Gateway, Third-Party Shipping API, Tax Calculation Service, Marketing/Email Service Provider
- **Containers**: Managed AWS API Gateway / Envoy Edge, Single Page Application (React on AWS S3/CloudFront), Catalog & Search Container, Order & Checkout Container, Recommendation Container, Localization Container, Analytics & Event Ingestion Container
- **API Gateway Components**: Edge Router & TLS Termination, Auth & Token Validator, Request Transformer, Traffic Policy & Throttling Component, Internal Routing & mTLS Dispatcher, Service Mesh Proxy

## Relationships
- **Book Buyer / Publisher -> AWS API Gateway**: Sends HTTPS traffic with JWT validation, OAuth 2.0 credentials, and rate-limiting [HTTPS, TLS 1.3]
- **AWS Route 53 -> AWS API Gateway**: Routes global latency-based traffic across us-east-1, eu-west-1, and ap-southeast-1 [DNS]
- **AWS API Gateway -> Backend Containers**: Dispatches internal requests securely [gRPC over mTLS via AWS App Mesh]
- **API Gateway -> Amazon CloudWatch & AWS X-Ray**: Centralizes access logs, telemetry, and tracing [AWS APIs]

## Technology Stack
- **Edge Routing & Ingress**: AWS API Gateway / Envoy-managed ingress, AWS Route 53, AWS WAF (Offloads TLS termination and OWASP Top-10 mitigations for R-07 and R-08)
- **Frontend**: React hosted on AWS S3 and distributed via CloudFront (Ensures <2s page load on 3G per R-06)
- **Backend & Services**: Node.js/Express, Spring Boot, Python/FastAPI, Go (Supports multi-domain retail business logic)
- **Data & Search**: Amazon OpenSearch, PostgreSQL (Provides high-performance catalog search and ACID transactions)
- **Messaging & Streaming**: Amazon Kinesis Firehose, Amazon SQS/SNS (Handles event ingestion and telemetry)
- **Security & Infrastructure**: AWS App Mesh, Amazon Cognito, AWS Secrets Manager, Terraform/CDK (Enforces mTLS, OAuth 2.0, and multi-region IaC consistency)

## Rationale
This architecture leverages managed AWS services like AWS API Gateway, WAF, and App Mesh to meet the 99.95% availability (R-07) and 1M MAU scalability (R-05) requirements without operational bloat. Edge-based security controls, JSON schema validation, and multi-region deployment ensure strict GDPR/CCPA compliance and OWASP mitigation (R-08).

Catalog & Search Container.analysis:
## Overview
This architecture defines the Catalog & Search container for the Online Bookstore, handling high-performance keyword search and product metadata management. It ensures sub-2-second page loads for 1M MAU while maintaining strict GDPR/CCPA compliance across three global AWS regions.

## Key Elements
- **Catalog API Controller**: Spring MVC component exposing endpoints for browsing and metadata retrieval.
- **Search Engine Service**: Spring Data component handling fuzzy matching and auto-complete via Amazon OpenSearch.
- **Product Metadata Repository**: Spring Data JPA component managing book details and inventory via PostgreSQL.
- **Review & Rating Aggregator**: Spring service for aggregating customer ratings.
- **Catalog Management Service**: Spring service processing admin-initiated updates.
- **Sync & Resilience Pipeline**: Debezium with AWS MSK (Kafka) for asynchronous Change Data Capture.

## Relationships
- API Gateway -> Catalog API Controller: Routes inbound requests [gRPC over mTLS via AWS App Mesh]
- Search Engine Service -> Amazon OpenSearch: Queries indices [HTTPS / REST]
- Product Metadata Repository -> PostgreSQL: Reads/Writes transactional data [JDBC / TCP]
- Catalog Management Service -> AWS MSK / Kafka: Publishes catalog change events [TCP]

## Technology Stack
- **Spring Boot**: Core framework for microservice components due to enterprise robustness.
- **Amazon OpenSearch**: Search engine selected for sub-second fuzzy matching and auto-complete.
- **PostgreSQL**: Relational database chosen for ACID-compliant transactional data integrity.
- **AWS MSK (Kafka) & Debezium**: Event streaming and CDC selected for decoupled, resilient data synchronization.
- **Terraform & ArgoCD**: Infrastructure-as-Code and GitOps for multi-region consistency across `us-east-1`, `eu-west-1`, and `ap-southeast-1`.

## Rationale
Decoupling the administrative write path from the buyer read path prevents bulk publisher updates from degrading storefront performance. Asynchronous CDC replication ensures high availability (99.95%) and low-latency global search capabilities.

Order & Checkout Container.analysis:
## Overview
- Secure, scalable Order & Checkout Container managing shopping carts, multi-currency payments, and fulfillment workflows for an online bookstore.
- Decouples transactional processing from third-party services using asynchronous messaging to ensure high availability and conversion protection.

## Key Elements
- **Book Buyer**: Primary persona executing purchases, guest checkouts, and multi-currency transactions.
- **Cart & Checkout Orchestrator**: Node.js/Express component managing state transitions, BOLA authorization, and the Outbox Pattern.
- **Payment Processor Client**: Handles secure, PCI-DSS compliant ephemeral card tokenization and interacts with the Payment Gateway.
- **Fulfillment & Tax Broker**: Handles asynchronous dispatch of shipping and tax events.
- **Guest Session Manager**: Manages transient guest tokens and ephemeral session state.
- **Payment Error Normalizer**: Maps raw gateway exceptions to localized error codes.
- **Order Database**: PostgreSQL instance storing orders and encrypted PII.
- **Session Cache**: Amazon ElastiCache (Redis) managing high-availability guest sessions.
- **External Systems**: Payment Gateway, Third-Party Shipping API, Tax Calculation Service.

## Relationships
- **API Gateway -> Order & Checkout Container**: Routes transactions via gRPC over mTLS using AWS App Mesh.
- **Cart & Checkout Orchestrator -> Order Database**: Persists relational data via TCP/SQL.
- **Cart & Checkout Orchestrator -> AWS SQS**: Dispatches asynchronous fulfillment events via AWS SDK / HTTPS.
- **Payment Processor Client -> Payment Gateway**: Processes card data via HTTPS with TLS 1.3.
- **Cart & Checkout Orchestrator -> Amazon ElastiCache (Redis)**: Manages guest sessions via TCP/RESP.

## Technology Stack
- **Node.js / Express / TypeScript**: Chosen for rapid asynchronous I/O and strong typing in financial workflows.
- **PostgreSQL**: Selected for robust ACID compliance and transactional safety using the Outbox Pattern.
- **Amazon ElastiCache (Redis)**: Implemented for high-availability transient guest session management.
- **AWS ECS (Fargate) & App Mesh**: Used for container orchestration, mTLS ingress, and payment circuit breaking.
- **AWS SQS**: Enables asynchronous decoupling of shipping and tax calculations from the core checkout flow.

## Rationale
- Decoupling third-party APIs with Amazon SQS prevents external latency from violating the 99.95% uptime SLA and harming conversion.
- Strict PCI-DSS scope minimization, Redis session controls, and AWS Secrets Manager ensure compliance, data protection, and resilience against card-testing attacks.

Recommendation Container.analysis:
## Overview
The Online Bookstore system is a scalable e-commerce platform providing catalog browsing, secure checkout, reviews, and personalized recommendations for physical and electronic books. It handles global traffic while ensuring high availability, performance, and compliance with data privacy regulations.

## Key Elements
- **Book Buyer**: Primary user accessing recommendations.
- **Recommendation Container (Python/FastAPI)**: Core backend container generating suggestions.
- **Recommendation API Router**: FastAPI component handling incoming gRPC/REST requests and Pydantic validation.
- **Personalization Engine**: Computes collaborative filtering and "Customers also bought" logic.
- **Cold-Start & Fallback Engine**: Serves trending books for new users or GDPR/CCPA opt-outs.
- **Data Access Layer**: Interfaces with storage using boto3.
- **Telemetry Event Emitter**: Asynchronously dispatches impression and click events.
- **Amazon DynamoDB**: Global database storing pre-computed recommendation vectors.
- **AWS SQS/SNS**: Messaging service with Dead-Letter Queues for telemetry events.

## Relationships
- **API Gateway -> Recommendation Container**: Requests personalized recommendations via gRPC over mTLS via AWS App Mesh.
- **Recommendation API Router -> Personalization & Fallback Engines**: Internal delegation based on user history and privacy flags.
- **Engines -> Amazon DynamoDB**: Reads recommendation data via AWS SDK (boto3) using TLS 1.3.
- **Telemetry Event Emitter -> Analytics Container**: Dispatches events asynchronously via AWS SQS/SNS.

## Technology Stack
- **Python / FastAPI**: Chosen for high-performance API routing and data science library integration.
- **Amazon DynamoDB (Global Tables)**: Selected for sub-millisecond read latency and cross-region replication.
- **AWS ECS (Fargate)**: Utilized for multi-AZ, multi-region container deployment across us-east-1, eu-west-1, and ap-southeast-1.
- **AWS SQS/SNS with DLQ**: Implemented for reliable, non-blocking asynchronous telemetry event dispatch.
- **Pydantic**: Used for strict input validation and sanitization.
- **AWS KMS**: Utilized for encryption at rest with customer-managed keys (CMK).

## Rationale
This architecture ensures sub-second responses and 99.95% uptime globally, meeting strict performance SLAs and 1M MAU scalability targets. It strictly enforces GDPR/CCPA compliance and OWASP Top-10 security controls through robust data minimization, IAM least-privilege, and regional isolation.

Localization Container.analysis:
## Overview
The Online Bookstore Localization Container manages multi-language translations, multi-currency conversions (USD, EUR, GBP), and regional shipping/tax rules for global book buyers. It is deployed on AWS to ensure high availability, low latency, and GDPR/CCPA compliance.

## Key Elements
- Book Buyers (International end-users)
- API Gateway (Node.js / Reverse Proxy)
- Localization Container (Node.js/Express)
- Locale Router & Middleware (Express.js)
- Translation Service Component (i18next)
- Currency Conversion Engine (Node.js/Axios)
- Geo-Resolution Adapter
- Amazon ElastiCache (Redis)
- External Third-Party FX APIs
- AWS Secrets Manager
- AWS ECS on Fargate & App Mesh

## Relationships
- API Gateway -> Locale Router: Requests localization and currency data via gRPC over mTLS using AWS App Mesh
- Currency Conversion Engine -> External Third-Party FX APIs: Fetches exchange rates via HTTPS (TLS 1.3)
- Currency Conversion Engine -> Amazon ElastiCache (Redis): Retrieves cached rates via internal TCP with TLS
- Locale Router -> Translation Service & Geo-Resolution Adapter: Internal component function calls

## Technology Stack
- Node.js & Express.js: Chosen for lightweight, high-throughput asynchronous request handling
- i18next: Selected for sub-millisecond multi-language string resolution
- Amazon ElastiCache (Redis): Used as an in-memory data store for low-latency currency and translation lookups, supporting NFR-06 (<2s page load)
- AWS ECS on Fargate & App Mesh: Provides container orchestration and secure mTLS service mesh routing across multiple regions
- AWS Secrets Manager: Ensures secure injection of third-party API credentials without hardcoding

## Rationale
This architecture uses localized in-memory caching and geo-resolution to minimize latency, protecting the sub-2-second page load requirement for global users. Multi-region ECS deployment with Redis failover guarantees 99.95% uptime and reliable multi-currency checkout during third-party outages.

Analytics & Event Ingestion Container.analysis:
## Overview
- Scaled-down Amazon-style e-commerce online bookstore for buying physical and electronic books with recommendations and reviews.
- Handles 1 million monthly active users (MAU) with 99.95% uptime while ensuring GDPR and CCPA compliance.

## Key Elements
- Book Buyer, Site Administrator, Customer Support Representative
- Single Page Application (React, AWS S3, CloudFront)
- API Gateway (Node.js, AWS App Mesh, JWT)
- Catalog & Search Container (Spring Boot, Amazon OpenSearch, PostgreSQL)
- Order & Checkout Container (Node.js/Express, PostgreSQL)
- Recommendation Container (Python/FastAPI)
- Localization Container (Node.js/Express)
- Analytics & Event Ingestion Container (Go, AWS Kinesis Firehose, Amazon SQS/SNS, SQLite/WAL)
- External Systems: Payment Gateway, Third-Party Shipping API, Tax Calculation Service, Marketing/Email Service Provider

## Relationships
- Single Page Application -> API Gateway: Communicates via HTTPS / REST
- API Gateway -> Catalog & Search Container, Order & Checkout Container, Recommendation Container, Localization Container: Routes requests via gRPC over mTLS
- API Gateway -> Analytics & Event Ingestion Container: Forwards telemetry and events via gRPC over mTLS via AWS App Mesh
- Analytics & Event Ingestion Container -> Marketing/Email Service Provider: Triggers marketing emails and event notifications via Amazon SQS/SNS
- Analytics & Event Ingestion Container -> AWS Kinesis Firehose: Streams telemetry via HTTPS / AWS SDK

## Technology Stack
- React, AWS S3, CloudFront: Powers responsive frontend UI with global CDN caching for fast page loads under 2s on 3G
- Node.js, Express, Go: Delivers high-performance, asynchronous backend routing and event ingestion
- Spring Boot, Python/FastAPI: Supports robust business logic and ML-based recommendation models
- PostgreSQL, Amazon OpenSearch: Provides relational data storage and fast keyword search capabilities
- AWS Kinesis Firehose, Amazon SQS/SNS: Enables scalable real-time telemetry streaming and reliable asynchronous messaging
- AWS ECS Fargate, AWS App Mesh: Facilitates containerized multi-region deployment across us-east-1, eu-west-1, and ap-southeast-1 with mTLS service mesh security

## Rationale
- Microservices architecture combined with AWS ECS Fargate ensures elastic scalability to handle 1M MAU across three global regions with 99.95% availability.
- Strict PII scrubbing at the ingress boundary and encrypted local buffering guarantee GDPR and CCPA compliance while maintaining high-throughput event processing.

    destination: "PII Scrubber and Processor"
    description: "Forwards raw events for scrubbing and validation."
  - source: "PII Scrubber and Processor"

  - source: "Local Buffer Manager"
    destination: "Stream Publisher"

Analytics & Event Ingestion Container.diagram:
@startuml
!include https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plantuml-stdlib/C4-PlantUML/master/C4_Component.puml
LAYOUT_WITH_LEGEND()

Container_Boundary("analytics_event_ingestion_container", "Analytics & Event Ingestion Container") {
    Component("Event Ingestion Receiver", "Event Ingestion Receiver", "Go", "Receives incoming telemetry and events from the API Gateway via gRPC.")
    Component("PII Scrubber and Processor", "PII Scrubber and Processor", "Go", "Scrubs sensitive PII data at the boundary to ensure GDPR and CCPA compliance.")
    Component("Local Buffer Manager", "Local Buffer Manager", "Go, SQLite/WAL", "Manages encrypted local buffering of events and telemetry for reliable processing.")
    Component("Stream Publisher", "Stream Publisher", "Go, AWS Kinesis Firehose", "Streams telemetry data securely via HTTPS using the AWS SDK.")
    Component("Notification Dispatcher", "Notification Dispatcher", "Go, Amazon SQS/SNS", "Triggers marketing emails and asynchronous event notifications to external providers.")
}

Rel("Event Ingestion Receiver", "PII Scrubber and Processor", "Forwards raw events for scrubbing and validation.", "gRPC")
Rel("PII Scrubber and Processor", "Local Buffer Manager", "Persists scrubbed events locally using SQLite with WAL.", "Internal")
Rel("Local Buffer Manager", "Stream Publisher", "Reads buffered data to stream via AWS Kinesis Firehose.", "Internal")
Rel("Local Buffer Manager", "Notification Dispatcher", "Sends asynchronous messages via Amazon SQS/SNS.", "Internal")

@enduml
